newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sudan says army helicopter shot down near Eritrea.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says army helicopter shot down near Eritrea.

text.p: The Sudanese army said on Monday that one of its helicopters was shot down by gunfire near the border with Eritrea, killing three of the crew.

The helicopter "came under a hail of gunfire from deep inside Eritrea", Sudan radio quoted an army statement as saying in a report monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation. "The country has lost a crew of three who were aboard."
It said the incident took place in the Rubsum area in the east of Sudan but did not say when.
Eritrea has allowed the Sudanese opposition in exile to set up military training camps close to the Sudanese border.
